name: Delmora
author: delmora

sections.description:
Delmora is the AI CRM for real estate companies. This plugin connects your WordPress website to your Delmora account:

  • Every form filled in on your site becomes a lead in Delmora, with the campaign that brought them. Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms and Formidable send their entries straight from your site’s server, so a visitor whose browser blocks trackers still reaches you.
  • Visitors, the pages they read and where they came from (campaigns, ads, social, search).
  • The AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and more) and search engines that read your pages.
  • Guides Delmora writes for your site, published as pages when you approve them.
  • What search engines and AI assistants look for, added where your site has none: your business details, a description, a link preview and llms.txt.
  • Google and Bing: Delmora adds the verification tags they check, so it can show your site’s searches.

A Delmora account is needed. No cookies are set. Passwords, card numbers and uploaded files are never read.

External services

This plugin connects your site to Delmora (delmora.ai), the CRM your company uses. It sends nothing until you connect it in Settings → Delmora.

Once connected:

  • Every page of your site loads Delmora’s site tag from t.delmora.ai. In the visitor’s browser it sends each page view (the page address and where the visitor came from) and each form entry (the fields filled in, never passwords, card numbers or files) to t.delmora.ai.
  • When a form plugin on your site receives an entry, your site’s server sends the same entry to t.delmora.ai, with the visitor’s browser name.
  • When a search engine or AI assistant reads a page, your site’s server sends the page address and that crawler’s name to t.delmora.ai.
  • Connecting opens delmora.ai, where you sign in and approve it; Delmora then sets the plugin’s site key, its guides, business details and verification tags through the WordPress REST API, with the application password you approved.

Delmora is provided by Delmora: terms of service https://delmora.ai/terms, privacy policy https://delmora.ai/privacy. Mention in your own privacy notice that your website’s visits and form entries go to your CRM.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New (search for “Delmora”) and activate it.
  2. Open Settings → Delmora and press Connect with Delmora. Sign in to Delmora and approve the connection. Nothing to copy or paste.
  3. Open your website once. Delmora shows it as live within a minute.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Delmora account?

Yes. The plugin shows your website in your Delmora account; without one it does nothing.

Which form plugins work?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms and Formidable, straight from the form plugin. Other forms that send like a normal web form work through the site tag.

Does it work with page caching?

Yes for visitors and forms. Search engines and AI assistants are seen when WordPress runs; pages served straight from a cache are not counted, so behind a cache that count is partial.

Does it slow my site down?

No. The site tag loads after your page, and the crawler reports are sent without waiting for an answer. A form entry waits at most a few seconds for Delmora.
sections.changelog:
0.5.0

  • Forms straight from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms and Formidable, so visitors who block trackers still become leads. Each entry arrives once.

0.4.0

  • Google and Bing: Delmora adds the two verification tags they check, so it can show the site’s searches in Analytics with nothing for you to do.
  • Updates arrive in Plugins like any other update.

0.3.0

  • Pages Delmora writes for your site, published by Delmora when you approve them.
  • What search engines and AI assistants need, added where your site has none: business details, a description, a link preview, llms.txt.

0.2.0

  • Connect with Delmora: sign in and approve, nothing to paste.
  • Removing the site in Delmora disconnects it here too.

0.1.0

  • First version: visitors, crawlers and forms.
